none: PAS NLM-EFECE7: Roman Coin: Nummus of Constantius II from Keelby
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus, probably of Constantius II (323-361), two Victories issue of 347-348, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Diademed bust right; the tail of diadem is visible, but more striking is the finely modelled spiky hair above it. Reverse description: Two Victories facing each other holding wreaths; between them a heart or leaf-shaped symbol. Reverse inscription: [VICT]O[RIAE]…
